question: 7 women A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). F is second to the right of C. A is third to the left of C. G is third to the left of F. D is not next to F. B is not next to A. Considering towards left of A, how many women are sitting between A and E?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing the centre

F is second to the right of C

A is third to the left of C

G is third to the left of F

D is not next to F

B is not next to A

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac655008f400a490b814f6d9b3f49bc4525992dd24cc55083015f00d15824ab5.png] 

 

So, number of persons between A and E = 0

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4.**
